post_result_audit_diagnosis.diagnosis: N3 was a false-negative audit implementation: witness search truncated to first 50 satisfying assignments after obfuscation.
post_result_audit_diagnosis.independent_nonaffinity_proof: Each boundary triple satisfies b -> (a XOR c = r), giving exactly 6 satisfying assignments. A nonempty affine Boolean relation has cardinality 2^d. For m triples the relation has 6^m assignments, never a power of two; therefore the frozen constructed semantics is non-affine.
post_result_audit_diagnosis.effect_on_verdict: None. N6 is a genuine independent resource-growth failure, so v6 remains unpromoted.

central_lesson: A small exact boundary certificate does not imply cheap certificate discovery or cheap compilation. The exponential pressure can migrate from output representation size into compilation/apply/quantification work.
